name: Venialbo (Spain)
description: Three diagonal bands from the lower hoist to the upper fly of red, blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Venialbo.
history: The full council of Venialbo, in session on 24 January 2003, agreed to approve the heraldic arms and municipal flag; the flag is rectangular, formed of three oblique stripes, red the upper, blue the central and gold the lower.

features.role: broad diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
red triangle at the upper fly
yellow triangle at the lower hoist
Venialbo arms — star and waves on red, a fleur-de-lis on blue and a church on green
